settings.contextAndPageLifetime: One browser process per session. For each run, one fresh browser context and one page per arm, opened immediately before that arm's first capture of the run and kept until the last pair of the run is captured, then closed. The warm-up pair has its own fresh context and page per arm, closed before run 1 begins. A smoke captures one pair under the same rule.

server.viteCache: one per arm, outside the served directory

meaning: One paired session under paired-same-session-v2. A session outcome is not a verdict: the verdict is computed from the registry over every qualifying session and is always worded with its denominator. A calibration has no candidate arm and qualifies nothing. No outcome here means the original absolute limits were met, a frame rate, a device or a human acceptance; see section 10 of the contract.
